title: Black CFO representation falls 25% from 2021 peak as diversity levels off
summary: The number of Black finance chiefs in Fortune 500 and S&P 500 companies ticked down to 15 this year, according to the report from Crist Kolder Associates.

title: District HR leaders: Keep humans in decision-making as AI’s presence grows
summary: With artificial intelligence gaining steam in school districts, some HR leaders also say the technology can help them be more efficient.

title: Hiring managers say they trust AI — but actively manage issues with it
summary: The volume of applications tripled in recent years, and while artificial intelligence tools help manage the influx, automation can only do so much, per a new study.

title: Pearson settles claims that workers with visual impairments couldn’t access training, benefits platforms
summary: Accessibility “cannot be an afterthought” when an employer uses online systems for such purposes, an EEOC attorney said.

title: SHRM tentatively backs end of EEO-1 reports, but investor group calls them ‘vital’
summary: The pair of public comments pushes back against EEOC’s assertion that the data collection program is overly burdensome.

title: Deloitte to pay $21.5M to settle claims its DEI programs violated federal civil rights law
summary: “Government contractors cannot reward or penalize employees based on race or sex,” the attorney general said.

title: McKinsey data sought in congressional DEI probe
summary: Brandon Gill, a Republican from Texas, decried McKinsey and Co.’s “heavy-handed” promotion of diversity, equity and inclusion practices through its oft-cited reports.

title: AI-related growth edges out job cut fears in finance execs’ tech outlook
summary: In an informal CFO Dive poll, 54% said they see AI’s biggest workforce impact being higher employee productivity.

title: AI is evolving faster than humans can assess how best to use it
summary: Existing frameworks aren’t equipped to understand what performance will look like in the artificial intelligence era, Talogy said in its report.

title: New York Times presses EEOC for White bias records in FOIA lawsuit
summary: The media giant alleged the agency has dragged its feet and ignored the Times’ inquiries about when its requests for information will be met.
